CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nothingsports_recovery.alias_guard_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ begin new.event_id := nothingsports_recovery.fixture_alias_v1(new.event_id); if tg_table_name='nothingsports_nsc_points' and tg_op='INSERT' then if exists(select 1 from public.nothingsports_nsc_points p where p.user_id=new.user_id and nothingsports_recovery.fixture_alias_v1(p.event_id)=new.event_id and p.action_key=new.action_key) then return null; end if; end if; return new; end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nothingsports_recovery.fixture_alias_v1(value text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ select coalesce(($aliases${"fixture:cricket:CA:40593": "fixture:cricket:espn:1525658", "fixture:rugby:wr:ac4f516c-300d-4f4b-85ea-514f0be5ddf6": "rugby-new-zealand-australia-2026-10-10", "evt_87": "fixture:cricket:espn:1525659", "evt_88": "fixture:cricket:espn:1525660", "evt_89": "fixture:cricket:espn:1525661", "fixture-cricket-espn-1525658": "fixture:cricket:espn:1525658", "fixture-cricket-espn-1525659": "fixture:cricket:espn:1525659", "fixture-cricket-espn-1525660": "fixture:cricket:espn:1525660", "fixture-cricket-espn-1525661": "fixture:cricket:espn:1525661"}$aliases$::jsonb)->>value,value) $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nothingsports_chat_active_rooms(target_user uuid, include_admin_rooms boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS TABLE(room_id uuid, canonical_fixture_id text, fixture_snapshot jsonb, room_name text, member_count bigint, unread_count bigint, last_message_at timestamp with time zone, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select
    r.id,
    r.canonical_fixture_id,
    r.fixture_snapshot,
    r.room_name,
    (select count(*) from public.nothingsports_chat_members all_members where all_members.room_id = r.id),
    case when own_membership.user_id is null then 0 else (
      select count(*)
      from public.nothingsports_chat_messages unread
      where unread.room_id = r.id
        and unread.sender_id <> target_user
        and unread.created_at > own_membership.last_read_at
    ) end,
    (select max(latest.created_at) from public.nothingsports_chat_messages latest where latest.room_id = r.id),
    r.created_at
  from public.nothingsports_chat_rooms r
  left join public.nothingsports_chat_members own_membership
    on own_membership.room_id = r.id and own_membership.user_id = target_user
  where r.status = 'open'
    and (include_admin_rooms or own_membership.user_id is not null)
  order by coalesce(
    (select max(latest.created_at) from public.nothingsports_chat_messages latest where latest.room_id = r.id),
    r.created_at
  ) desc;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nothingsports_read_current_fixtures(p_fixture_ids text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[])
 RETURNS TABLE(source_id text, fixture_id text, fixture jsonb, identity_keys text[])
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select c.source_id,c.fixture_id,c.fixture||coalesce(s.score,'{}'::jsonb)||case when s.first_completed_at is null then '{}'::jsonb else jsonb_build_object('firstConfirmedCompleteAt',s.first_completed_at) end,c.identity_keys
 from public.nothingsports_fixture_current c left join public.nothingsports_live_scores s using(source_id,fixture_id)
 where p_fixture_ids is null or c.identity_keys && p_fixture_ids order by c.source_id,c.fixture_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nothingsports_record_watching_heartbeat(target_event_id text, target_user_id uuid, heartbeat_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT clock_timestamp())
 RETURNS TABLE(heartbeat_count integer, watching_started_at timestamp with time zone, last_heartbeat_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  insert into public.nothingsports_nsc_presence as presence(
    event_id,user_id,watching_started_at,last_heartbeat_at,heartbeat_count
  ) values(target_event_id,target_user_id,heartbeat_at,heartbeat_at,1)
  on conflict(event_id,user_id) do update
  set watching_started_at=case
        when presence.last_heartbeat_at < heartbeat_at-interval '10 minutes' then heartbeat_at
        else presence.watching_started_at
      end,
      last_heartbeat_at=heartbeat_at,
      heartbeat_count=case
        when presence.last_heartbeat_at < heartbeat_at-interval '10 minutes' then 1
        else presence.heartbeat_count+1
      end
  returning presence.heartbeat_count,presence.watching_started_at,presence.last_heartbeat_at;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nothingsports_reminder_schedule_candidates()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, event_id text, delivery_mode text, starts_at timestamp with time zone, updated_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET statement_timeout TO '3s'
AS $function$
 select r.id,r.event_id,r.delivery_mode,r.starts_at,r.updated_at from public.nothingsports_reminders r
 where r.dispatched_at is null and r.delivery_mode='match-15' and public.nothingsports_managed_reminder(r.event_id,r.delivery_mode)
 and (r.claimed_at is null or r.claimed_at<clock_timestamp()-interval '10 minutes')
 and not exists(select 1 from public.nothingsports_account_erasure_blocks b where b.user_id=r.user_id)
 and not exists(select 1 from public.nothingsports_push_installations i join public.nothingsports_account_erasure_blocks b on b.user_id=i.user_id where i.installation_id=r.installation_id)
 order by r.schedule_checked_at nulls first,r.id limit 20
$function$
